name: Hidden Power
description:
Your <rt.warning>abilities</> have a <rt.bold>chance</> to grant you 1 stack of <rt.bold>Hidden Power</> for <rt.bold>60 seconds</>. When you have <rt.bold>5 stacks</>, <rt.warning>Hidden Power is consumed</> and <rt.bold>Power Revealed</> is granted to you for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>, increasing your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> by <rt.effect>7.2%</> / <rt.effect>12.8%</> / <rt.effect>18.4%</> / <rt.effect>24%</>.

You can not gain <rt.bold>Hidden Power</> stacks while <rt.bold>Power Revealed</> is active on you.

<rt.bold>(2.6 PPM)</>

name: The Beetle
description:
When you take damage equal to <bold>40% of your max health or more in a single hit</>, the damage is <bold>reduced by 30%</>.

This can only occur once every 20 seconds.

name: The Shadow
description: Your <bold>Magic Damage Reduction</> is increased by <bold>10%</>.

name: The Lake
description: You take <bold>20% reduced Area of Effect damage</>.

name: Inspired Allegiance
description:
Your <rt.warning>abilities</> have a <rt.bold>chance</> to reduce the <rt.bold>Cooldown</> of your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> by <rt.effect>1.5</> / <rt.effect>4</> / <rt.effect>6</> / <rt.effect>8</> seconds and grant you and <rt.effect>1</> / <rt.effect>2</> / <rt.effect>3</> / <rt.effect>3</> allies <rt.effect>6</> / <rt.effect>10</> / <rt.effect>13</> / <rt.effect>17</> <rt.warning>Haste</> rating for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

<rt.bold>(1.2 PPM)</>

name: Inspired Arms
description: Upon using your Weapon Ability, you gain 10% Cooldown Acceleration for a duration equal to 10% / 12% / 14% / 16% of your Weapon Ability's default cooldown duration.

name: Seized Opportunity
description:
<rt.warning>Every 20 Critical Strikes</> you gain <rt.effect>21</> / <rt.effect>39</> / <rt.effect>57</> / <rt.effect>75</> <rt.warning>Critical Strike</> rating for <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

You can not gain stacks while <rt.bold>Seized Opportunity</> is active on you.

name: Vengeful Soul
description:
Your <rt.warning>critical strikes</> have a <rt.bold>chance</> to increase your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> by <rt.effect>3.0%</> / <rt.effect>5.1%</> / <rt.effect>7.2%</> / <rt.effect>9.3%</> for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

<rt.warning>If you are below 50% health</> when <rt.bold>Vengeful Soul</> triggers, you are also <rt.heal>healed</> for an amount equal to <rt.effect>370%</> / <rt.effect>630%</> / <rt.effect>890%</> / <rt.effect>1150%</> of your <rt.heal>Main Stat</> over <rt.bold>6 seconds</>.

<rt.bold>(3.0 PPM)</>

name: King of the Hill
description: You take <rt.effect>3%</> / <rt.effect>6%</> / <rt.effect>9%</> / <rt.effect>12%</> <rt.bold>Reduced Damage</> while you are above <rt.bold>80% health</>.

name: The Mountain
description:
When you take damage that would kill you, your health is set to <bold>1</> and you are <bold>Immune to damage for 3 seconds</>.

This effect can only happen once every 480 seconds.

name: Kindling
description:
Your <rt.warning>Damage Effects</> have a chance <rt.bold>(2.1 PPM)</> to burn the target, dealing <rt.effect>483%</> / <rt.effect>882%</> / <rt.effect>1281%</> / <rt.effect>1680%</> of your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> in fire damage to them <rt.bold>over 9 seconds</>.

Your <rt.heal>Healing Effects</> have a chance <rt.bold>(2.1 PPM)</> to cauterize the target, healing them for <rt.effect>483%</> / <rt.effect>882%</> / <rt.effect>1281%</> / <rt.effect>1680%</> of your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> over <rt.bold>9 seconds</>.

name: First Man Standing
description: <rt.warning>Each time an enemy deals damage to you for the first time</>, you gain <rt.bold>First Man Standing</>, <rt.bold>reducing all damage</> you take by <rt.effect>3.0%</> / <rt.effect>5.2%</> / <rt.effect>7.4%</> / <rt.effect>9.6%</> for <rt.bold>20 seconds</>.

name: Topaz Winds
description:
Your abilities have a chance to increase your Cooldown Recovery by 30% / 36% / 42% / 48% for 15 seconds.

(1.0 PPM)

name: Amethyst Splinters
description:
When you deal <rt.warning>Critical Damage to an enemy</>, you deal an additional <rt.effect>4%</> / <rt.effect>6%</> / <rt.effect>8%</> / <rt.effect>11%</> of that damage to them over <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

When you <rt.heal>Critically Heal an ally</>, they are healed for an additional <rt.effect>4%</> / <rt.effect>6%</> / <rt.effect>8%</> / <rt.effect>11%</> of that amount over <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

<rt.bold>Amethyst Splinters</> can not critically strike.

name: Sapphire Aurastone
description:
Your <rt.absorb>Spirit Ability</> causes you to conjure a <rt.bold>Sapphire Aurastone</> near you or your selected target on activation. The Sapphire Aurastone lasts as long as the <rt.effect>Spirit of Heroism</> effect from your <rt.absorb>Spirit Ability</> is active on you.

While active, <rt.effect>3.4%</> / <rt.effect>6.3%</> / <rt.effect>9.1%</> / <rt.effect>12%</> of <rt.warning>all damage you deal is accumulated</> into the <rt.bold>Sapphire Aurastone</> and released in a <rt.warning>pulse of damage</>, evenly split between nearby enemies every <rt.bold>3 seconds</>.

While active, <rt.effect>4.6%</> / <rt.effect>8.4%</> / <rt.effect>12%</> / <rt.effect>16%</> of <rt.heal>all healing you do is accumulated</> into the <rt.bold>Sapphire Aurastone</> and released in a <rt.heal>pulse of healing</>, evenly split between nearby allies every <rt.bold>3 seconds</>.

Each pulse empties the accumulated <rt.warning>Damage</> or <rt.heal>Healing</> stored within it.

name: Diamond Strike
description:
Your <rt.warning>Damage</> has a <rt.bold>chance (6.7 PPM)</> to conjure a Spectral Beam from above, dealing <rt.effect>72%</> / <rt.effect>127%</> / <rt.effect>182%</> / <rt.effect>237%</> <rt.warning>Main Stat</> damage to them.

Your <rt.heal>Heals</> have a <rt.bold>chance (6.7 PPM)</> to conjure a Spectral Beam from above, healing them for an additional <rt.effect>72%</> / <rt.effect>127%</> / <rt.effect>182%</> / <rt.effect>237%</> of your <rt.heal>Main Stat</>.

<rt.bold>Diamond Strike</> applies an amplifying effect for <rt.bold>20 seconds</> on targets it strikes, increasing its <rt.warning>Damage</> and <rt.heal>Healing</> to that target by <rt.bold>40%</>, <rt.bold>stacking up to 5 times</>.

<rt.bold>Diamond Strike</> gains an additional <rt.bold>+35%</> increased <rt.warning>Damage</> and <rt.heal>Healing</> for every stack of <rt.MeikoAbility3>Harmonious Soul</> you have active <rt.MeikoAbility3>(Diamond Gem Power)</>.

name: Emerald Judgement
description:
Each time you <rt.warning>deal damage to an enemy</>, you have a <rt.bold>chance</> <rt.bold>(</><rt.effect>0.8 PPM</> / <rt.effect>1.30 PPM</> / <rt.effect>1.80 PPM</> / <rt.effect>2.30 PPM</><rt.bold>)</> to conjure an Emerald Spike out of the ground, <rt.bold>knocking that enemy into the air</> and dealing  <rt.warning>800% Main Stat damage</> to them.

<rt.bold>Emerald Judgement</> triggers your current rank of <rt.MeikoAbility3>First Strike (Emerald Gem Power)</>.

name: Ruby Storm
description:
Your targeted, offensive abilities have a chance to spawn a <rt.bold>Ruby Storm</> that travels forward, <rt.warning>dealing damage to all enemies it touches</> equal to <rt.effect>2.4%</> / <rt.effect>4.0%</> / <rt.effect>5.4%</> / <rt.effect>7.0%</> of your <rt.bold>Current Health</>.

<rt.bold>(1.3 PPM)</>

name: Iron Spikes
description:
<rt.warning>Taking damage</> has a <rt.bold>chance</> to increase your <rt.bold>Armor</> by <rt.effect>10%</> / <rt.effect>17%</> / <rt.effect>24%</> / <rt.effect>32%</> for <rt.bold>10 seconds</>. While this is active, you deal <rt.effect>16%</> / <rt.effect>29%</> / <rt.effect>42%</> / <rt.effect>55%</> <rt.warning>Main Stat physical damage</> to enemies who deal damage to you.

<rt.bold>(1.5 PPM)</>

name: Divine Mediation
description:
<rt.warning>Taking damage</> has a <rt.bold>chance</> to <rt.heal>Heal you</> for <rt.effect>332%</> / <rt.effect>572%</> / <rt.effect>816%</> / <rt.effect>1056%</> <rt.heal>Main Stat</> over <rt.bold>6 seconds</>.

<rt.warning>Once the heal expires</>, you apply an <rt.heal>Absorb Shield on yourself and all allies</> equal to <rt.effect>240%</> / <rt.effect>416%</> / <rt.effect>592%</> / <rt.effect>768%</> <rt.heal>Main Stat</>.

Damage dealt to the shield is <rt.heal>reduced by 50%</>.

<rt.bold>(1.0 PPM)</>

name: Latent Resurgence
description:
<rt.warning>When you are healed</>, you have a <rt.bold>chance</> to gain 1 stack of <rt.bold>Latent Resurgence</> up to a maximum of <rt.bold>10 stacks</>.

<rt.warning>When your health dips below 50%</> all stacks of <rt.bold>Latent Resurgence</> are consumed, instantly <rt.heal>Healing</> you for an amount equal to <rt.effect>108%</> / <rt.effect>188%</> / <rt.effect>268%</> / <rt.effect>348%</> of your <rt.heal>Main Stat</> <rt.bold>per stack</>.

<rt.bold>Latent Resurgence</> will attempt to save your life if the damage brings you below zero health.

<rt.bold>(3.3 PPM)</>

name: Willful Momentum
description:
Your <rt.warning>Spirit</> Rating is increased by <rt.effect>7</> / <rt.effect>11</> / <rt.effect>17</> / <rt.effect>23</>.

Whenever you trigger a <rt.effect>Spirit Refund</> your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> is increased by <rt.effect>1.5%</> / <rt.effect>2.6%</> / <rt.effect>3.7%</> / <rt.effect>4.8%</> for <rt.bold>4 seconds</>.

name: Heart of Stone
description: You gain <rt.effect>2.5%</> / <rt.effect>4.7%</> / <rt.effect>7.0%</> / <rt.effect>9.3%</> more <rt.bold>Health</> from <rt.bold>Stamina</>.

name: Stalwart Readiness
description:
Every <rt.bold>4 seconds</> in combat that you do not take damage, you gain 1 stack of <rt.bold>Stalwart Readiness</>.

The <rt.warning>next time you take any damage</> it is <rt.bold>Reduced by</> <rt.effect>2% / 3% / 4.5% / 6%</> for each stack of <rt.bold>Stalwart Readiness</> you have and <rt.bold>1 stack is removed</>.

You can have a maximum of <rt.bold>3</> stacks of <rt.bold>Stalwart Readiness</>.

name: Hunter's Focus
description:
Your <rt.warning>targeted offensive abilities</> grant you <rt.effect>4</> / <rt.effect>8</> / <rt.effect>12</> / <rt.effect>16</> <rt.warning>Haste</> rating for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>, stacking up to <rt.bold>5</> times.

The <rt.warning>Haste</> is lost if you use a targeted offensive ability on any other enemy.

name: Navigator's Intuition
description:
Your offensive abilities have a <rt.bold>20% chance</> to grant you <rt.effect>28</> / <rt.effect>66</> / <rt.effect>104</> / <rt.effect>142</> <rt.warning>Critical Strike</>, <rt.warning>Haste</>, <rt.warning>Expertise</> <rt.bold>or</> <rt.warning>Spirit</> rating for <rt.bold>30 seconds</>. Your highest secondary stat is always the one that gets increased.

<rt.bold>Navigator's Intuition</> can trigger <rt.bold>once every 90 seconds</>.

name: Treasure Hunter's Delight
description: <rt.warning>When you use a</> <rt.absorb>Relic Ability</>, all <rt.bold>damage you take is reduced</> by <rt.effect>4.7%</> / <rt.effect>7.8%</> / <rt.effect>10.9%</> / <rt.effect>14%</> for <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

name: Grounded Spirit
description:
<rt.warning>Every 1 second that you stand still</>, you gain 1 stack of <rt.bold>Grounded Spirit</> up to <rt.bold>10 stacks</>.

<rt.warning>Upon moving</>, all stacks of <rt.bold>Grounded Spirit</> are consumed, <rt.heal>healing you and 1 other ally with low health</> for <rt.effect>60%</> / <rt.effect>116%</> / <rt.effect>172%</> / <rt.effect>228%</> <rt.heal>Main Stat</> <rt.bold>per stack consumed</>.

name: Patient Soul
description:
<rt.warning>Standing still for 3 seconds</> grants you <rt.bold>Patient Soul</>, increasing your <rt.heal>Max Health</> by <rt.heal>5%</> and your <rt.warning>Expertise</> rating by <rt.effect>12</> / <rt.effect>22</> / <rt.effect>32</> / <rt.effect>42</>.

<rt.bold>Patient Soul</> <rt.bold>persists for 6 seconds</> after you start moving.

name: The Oak
description: Your <bold>Armor is increased by 35%</>.

name: Visions of Grandeur
description:
Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> generates <rt.warning>2.5 Spirit Points</> multiplied by a value equal to your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> default cooldown, divided by 30.

Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> <rt.bold>Cooldown</> is reduced by <rt.effect>25%</> / <rt.effect>50%</> / <rt.effect>75%</> / <rt.effect>100%</> when you activate your <rt.absorb>Spirit Ability</>.

name: Brave Machinations
description:
Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> <rt.warning>Critical Strike chance</> is increased by <rt.effect>9.5%</> / <rt.effect>17%</> / <rt.effect>24%</> / <rt.effect>32%</>.

If your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> deals a <rt.warning>Critical Strike</>, its <rt.bold>Cooldown</> is reduced by <rt.effect>15%</> / <rt.effect>20%</> / <rt.effect>25%</> / <rt.effect>30%</>.

name: Martial Initiative
description: Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> grants you <rt.warning>10% increased Main Stat</> and <rt.bold>15% Damage Reduction</> for a duration equal to <rt.effect>10%</> / <rt.effect>18%</> / <rt.effect>25%</> / <rt.effect>32%</> of your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> default cooldown.

name: Heroic Brand
description: Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> <rt.warning>Damage</> and <rt.heal>Healing</> is increased by <rt.effect>24%</> / <rt.effect>42%</> / <rt.effect>60%</> / <rt.effect>80%</>.
